memberships.page_title: Exact Normal Linearization at the Plane Boundary

statement: Over an infinite characteristic-zero field, every finite jet of a formal two-variable Jacobian-one automorphism fixing the origin is matched by a polynomial Jacobian-one automorphism composed of linear SL2 maps and polynomial shears.
title: Every Finite Area-Preserving Jet Is Polynomially Realizable
